newsitem.title: USA: Astro-Med gets FDA OK for EEG system.
newsitem.headline: Astro-Med gets FDA OK for EEG system.

text.p: Astro-Med Inc said Monday it had received Food and Drug Administration clearance to market and sell its Digital Electroencephalograph (EEG) for monitoring and analyzing neurophysiological disorders.

Called the Albert Grass Heritage, the system combines Grass amplifiers and other hardware with a software program called Harmonie and a Pentium PC into a Digital System. The Albert Grass Heritage is the first in a new family of digital products that are being designed and developed for clinical and research applications.
Depending on the number of channels, the Heritage ranges in price for $30,000 to $40,000.
Availability ranges from immediate shipment from stock to two weeks after the receipt of an order.
